newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy October truck registrations fall slightly.
newsitem.headline: Italy October truck registrations fall slightly.

text.p: Italian commercial vehicle registrations in October fell 0.30 percent to 13,391 units from 13,431 in October 1995, said a joint statement from makers association Anfia and importing body Unrae.
Domestic Italian manufacturers including Fiat and its trucks unit Iveco and also Bremack and Piaggio, saw their share of the Italian market slip to 52.05 percent from 57.44 percent in October 1995.
Manufacturers from outside Italy saw their October 1996 market share rise to 47.95 percent from 42.56 percent in October 1995, with sales rising to 6,421 from 5,716.
Among the Italian manufacturers, Fiat Auto saw a sales fall of 6.8 percent, Iveco a decline of 22.4 percent, while Piaggio saw an increase of 15.3 percent.

For the first ten months of 1996, commercial vehicles registered a rise of 1.99 percent to 120,195 units. Italian makers saw a rise of 5.15 percent to 67,467 units (market share of 56.13 percent) and foreign makers a fall of 1.78 percent to 52,728 unit (market share of 43.87 percent).
